title: Work and energy
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:36Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: None of the bank points teaches work as force times distance or the near-surface forms ½mv² and mgh; the closest, the escape velocity card, covers gravitational potential energy as -GMm/r at a much greater depth, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Work and energy
card: Work is done when a force moves an object. W = Fs, where s is the distance moved in the direction of the force. It is measured in joules (J).
Work transfers energy. Doing work on an object changes its energy by the same amount.
the energy of motion. Ek = ½mv². Doubling the speed makes the kinetic energy four times larger.
the energy stored by height in a gravitational field. Ep = mgh, with g about 9.8 m/s² near Earth's surface.
draft.remember: Work is force times distance. Energy of motion is ½mv² and energy of height is mgh.

a.q: A trolley is pushed with a steady force of 40 N along a level path for 5.0 m. How much work is done on the trolley?
a.why: Work = force × distance = 40 × 5.0 = 200 J. Dividing the two numbers gives 8.0, but work is found by multiplying them.
a.clue: Multiply the force by the distance moved.

b.q: A cyclist on a flat road speeds up from 5 m/s to 10 m/s. By what factor does her kinetic energy increase?
b.why: Kinetic energy depends on v². Doubling the speed multiplies v² by 4, so the energy is four times larger. It is not doubled, because speed is squared in the formula.
b.clue: Look at how speed appears in ½mv².
